deadline.value: UNSW sets closing dates per scholarship round and term; the international round for Term 2 or 3 2027 closed on 14 August 2026.

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's with first or upper second-class honours is enough to start a PhD, with no master's required.
entry_route.quote: The minimum entry requirement for a PhD is a four-year Bachelor’s degree with First or Upper Second Class honours

supervisor.value: You must get a BABS academic to agree to supervise you before you apply.
supervisor.quote: Applicants must seek and obtain agreement of a BABS academic to be their supervisor prior to applying

funding.value: Stipends come through scholarships that are applied for separately, so the page does not promise funding to every admitted student.
funding.quote: We assist postgraduate researchers with a range of prestigious scholarships with annual stipends

toefl_min.value: Science research degrees need TOEFL iBT 90 overall, with at least 23 in writing and 22 in the other sections.
toefl_min.quote: 90 overall (min. 23 in writing, 22 in reading, listening and speaking)

ielts_min.value: Science research degrees need IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with at least 6.0 in each band.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

notes: The biology study-area page lists 'Doctor of Philosophy (PhD)'. The BABS page lists research teams in metabolism, molecular and cell biology, neurogenomics and structural biology.
